name: Unturned
short_description: Unturned is an open-world zombie survival sandbox game. As one of the few not yet turned, you must fight to remain among the living.
detailed_description:
SURVIVE THE APOCALYPSE: Scavenge for supplies, hunt for food, and build shelter in a world overrun by zombies.

EXPLORE MASSIVE LEVELS: Travel by air, land, and sea while discovering hidden secrets and NPCs to help and trade with.

BUILD YOUR HOME: Fortify your base before heading back out to retrieve airdrops, scout deadzones, and battle hordes of supernatural undead.

COOPERATE OR FIGHT: Team up with friendly players to arrest the bandits, or face-off in intense PvP raids.

TRULY FREE-TO-PLAY: No pay-to-win mechanics, only cosmetic items to further customize your character.

ENDLESS CREATIVITY: Create, share, and experience custom maps and mods through the Steam Workshop.

SOURCE CODE: From new features to total conversions, you can rebuild the game with source code and project files available on GitHub.
